title: Second Battle of El Alamein
summary: From 23 October to 4 November 1942 the British Eighth Army under Montgomery attacked the Axis army under Rommel at El Alamein in Egypt, with about 200,000 men and as many as 1,200 tanks. The Allied victory forced a retreat that ended in Tunisia.

as_recorded.value: The Battle of El Alamein, 23 October 1942

where.historical_name: El Alamein front, Western Desert, Egypt

importance.justification: Described as Montgomery's first great offensive victory that forced Rommel into a retreat ending at the Mareth Line.
